figures.caption: Fig. 4. Classifier behaviour during a complete TSST session for participants P6 (top) and P16 (bottom) using both sensors. The y-axis represents the output of the classifier which is 1 for stressful tasks, and -1 for nonstressful tasks. The x-axis indicates each instant time in seconds during the TSST and the corresponding task: NT 1 (First Neutral Task), PP (Presentation Preparation), PS (Public Speaking), Cognitive Task (CG), NT 2 (Second Neutral Task). The continuous line indicates the right label for each time instant, and red diamonds indicate the predicted values from the classifier.
